messages:
ana: Heads-up  recent spike test showed dedicated pools returning 503s due to packing failures + optimistic admission. Need a compact plan.
rohit: Short proposal: signed burst vouchers (credits + pack_hint) + predictive prewarm scoring. Vouchers handled locally for O(1) admission.
diane: Pack_hint should be explicit: contig_small / contig_large / any. Local allocator tries contig first if requested. If fail, and voucher allows fallback, try any-fit and tag fallback.
ana: (typo) ana: +1; also add a lease TTL so vouchers can't be replayed after a scale-down. TTL <= 30m for now.
rohit: Credit model: baseline by tier + ephemeral earned credits (leaky bucket). Earned credits require sustained activity (>180s) to avoid gaming. Half-life ~45m.
diane: Operator-level compaction: run only during low-util windows and when compaction_gain_estimate > 1.5x cost_estimate. Emit metrics: fragmentation_ratio, fallback_rate.
orch-bot: deploy:burst-vouchers queued for staging. PR #6120
ana: Action items: rohit implement voucher schema + KMS signing; diane prototype allocator fallback tagging; ana add console metrics and billing tags. Sync tomorrow 10am.
